notes: VAT 12% (PwC); the jewellery VAT exemption is abolished from 1 Jan 2026, from when gold/silver jewellery carry 12%. The Central Bank sells 999.9 gold bars (5-100 g) via banks, publishing daily sell/buyback prices: on 27 Nov 2026 buyback was 16.1% below selling at all sizes (10 g: sell 16,277,000 UZS, buyback 13,656,000 UZS). No bar premium: no primary spot price read.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Uzbekistan, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: VAT rate for taxable turnover is 12%; starting 1 January 2026 the VAT exemptions on the sale of jewellery and semi-finished products made of precious metals are abolished and jewellery businesses are recognised as VAT payers. Customs duty rates vary from 5% to 70% depending on the goods, with no gold-specific rate stated.

Buyback is 16.1% below the selling price at every size.
